LESSON: INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: Inspired Word of God
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Inspired Word of God, part of The Bible in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is the Bible different from other books?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the meaning of ‘Bible is the inspired Word of God’,

2. compose and sing a song on ‘the Bible as an inspired Word of God’,

3. read 2 Timothy 3:16-17 and explain the meaning of the text,

4. name authors who were inspired to write the Old and New Testament,

5. use digital devices to search for reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages,

6. identify the advantages of translating the Bible into local languages.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the meaning of ‘Bible is the inspired Word of God’,
2. compose and sing a song on ‘the Bible as an inspired Word of God’,
3. read 2 Timothy 3:16-17 and explain the meaning of the text,
4. name authors who were inspired to write the Old and New Testament,
5. use digital devices to search for reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages,
6. identify the advantages of translating the Bible into local languages.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Inspired Word of God together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners, in groups, identify the advantages of

translating the Bible into local languages.

• Imagination and creativity: the skill of originality is enhanced as learners compose and sing a song on, ‘The Bible as an

inspired Word of God’.

• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners use digital devices to perform

various tasks.

Values:
Respect: learners accept and appreciate the opinions of others as they discuss, in groups, the advantages of translating the

Bible into local languages .

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners compose and sing a song on, ‘The Bible as an inspired Word of God.’

• Science and Technology skills are applied as learners use digital devices to search for reasons that led to translation of the

Bible into local languages.
